s: Hello, and welcome to Muse English!
Today we talk about your body and your health.
A healthy body is a happy body.
A diet is the food and drink you eat every day.
Eating a healthy diet gives you energy.
Fruit, vegetables, bread, and water are part of a good diet.
In the morning, I eat fruit.
At dinner, I eat fish and rice.
My diet helps me stay strong.
Do you eat a lot of sweet food?
A good diet has a little sweet food and a lot of healthy food.
My diet is good for my body.
I eat apples, cheese, and bread.
A good diet is part of a healthy life.
Your chest is the front of your body, between your neck and your stomach.
Put your hand on your chest.
Your heart is in your chest.
Your chest goes up and down when you breathe.
When I run, my chest moves fast.
When I rest, my chest is calm.
A pain in your chest is not good.
If you have a pain in your chest, see a doctor soon.
Your chest is part of your body.
Take care of your chest and your body.

A dentist is a doctor for your teeth.
A dentist takes care of your teeth.
I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow.
The dentist looks at my teeth.
The dentist is kind and helps me.
I see the dentist two times a year.
A good dentist helps your teeth stay strong and white.
Do not be afraid of the dentist.
Brush your teeth every day, and the dentist will be happy.
Cancer is a very serious illness.
It is a sad word, but it is good to know it.
Doctors are looking for a cure for cancer.
Many doctors work hard to help people with cancer.
A healthy diet and a healthy life can help your body.
But cancer is a big illness, and doctors help people with cancer every day.
To die is to stop living.
It is a sad word too.
My old dog died last year.
My dog was old, and then he died.
We remember the ones who die.
